name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: The class contains the subfamily $\{\{i\}:i\in[n]\}$ of all singleton concepts. Its absent all-zero trace and its $n$ realized one-coordinate neighbours form a hollow $n$-star, giving a lower bound of $n$ for the subfamily envelope. Every subfamily remains on the same $n$-coordinate domain, so no projected hollow star has more than $n$ coordinates. Thus the envelope is exactly $n$, including $n=1$. This upper bound uses ambient domain size, not the refuted general effective-range comparison.
